    Products of bilinear forms #

    The product of two bilinear forms is the block-diagonal form on the product module: each factor carries its own form and the two factors are orthogonal to each other. It is the bilinear counterpart of QuadraticMap.prod, and it is the form an orthogonal direct sum of bilinear modules carries.

    Nondegeneracy is componentwise: a vector is in the radical of the product exactly when both of its components are in the radicals of the factors.
